evidence: The paper develops ML models (random forest, XGBoost, GBM, ANN) for SAG mill optimization but never reports variable importance or feature importance scores. Variable relationships are identified via Spearman correlation: "The Spearman correlation study (see Figure 3) indicates a strong relationship between SAG production and SAG water feeding." Conclusions depend on model-based simulation of scenarios, reporting outcomes like "4.42% increase in production" and "7.62% energy savings," not on importance magnitude or ranking.
